name: Lao Feng Xiang Co., Ltd.
summary: Lao Feng Xiang Co., Ltd. operates in the jewelry industry in the People's Republic of China and internationally. It researches, designs, produces, and sells gold, platinum, diamonds, silver, white jade, jadeite, pearls, colored gemstones, enamel, K-gold jewelry eyeglasses, coral, watches, amber, brooches, and arts and crafts souvenirs. The company was formerly known as China First Pencil Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Lao Feng Xiang Co., Ltd. in July 2009. Lao Feng Xiang Co., Ltd. was founded in 1848 and is based in Shanghai, the People's Republic of China.
